image_description: The image displays three Great White Pelicans interacting in a body of water. One pelican is captured mid-flight with wings fully extended, showing dark flight feathers against white plumage. A second pelican stands in shallow water on the left, displaying its long bill and gular pouch. A third pelican is partially submerged or swimming in the center background. The scene includes rippling water and a blurred shoreline in the background.
